subject: Signal and System
questionText:
A stable system has input x(t) = e-t u(t) and output y(t) 
= e–2t cost u(t). The impulse response of the system is 
 
(a) 𝛿𝛿(t) – (e–2t cos t + e–2t sin t) u(t) 
 
(b) 𝛿𝛿(t) – (e–2t cos t + e–2t sin t) u(t – 2) 
 
(c) 𝛿𝛿(t) – (e–2t cos t + e2t sin t) u(t) 
 
(d) 𝛿𝛿(t) – (e2t cos t + e2t sin t) u(t + 2)
explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-21 (System Analysis Using Laplace Transform).
